manual.text:
## Specific task description

Task instruction: Pick the red can and the can with gold logo design at once, then place them into the smooth exterior blue plasticbox.

Task description: Pick up the red can on the left and the can with a gold logo on the right, and place both into the smooth-walled blue plastic box in the middle.

Success criteria: Both cans are inside the blue plastic box, each horizontally near one of the two designated placement locations in the box; both grippers are open and have released the cans.

## Execution tips

- Consider having the left and right grippers approach the left and right cans respectively, leaving space between the arms while lifting to reduce collisions from crossing paths.
- Grip the straight upper-middle can wall, avoiding the lid and rolled rim, and open slightly wider than its diameter. Before closing, confirm the fingers are on opposing sides to avoid pushing it over from one side.
- When approaching the box opening, keep both can bottoms and fingertips above the rim and maintain gaps between cans and grippers to avoid walls or mutual squeezing. Reorient above the opening where space permits.
- Leave room at placement for the can body, box walls, and opening fingers. Support the can bottom on the box bottom before release, then withdraw through a gap to reduce tipping or lifting the can with the fingers.
